_comment: Frozen identity of the gb-engine StatefulSet (migration plan 12.3 item 5, ADR-0005/0007, Phase 2B Decision D). validate.py compares every non-ci entry point against this file; a change here is a change to immutable StatefulSet fields and means deleting and recreating the StatefulSet. accessModes/storageClassName are part of the identity too: the RWO fallback (ADR-0007) must be chosen here before the first PVC exists.
name: gb-engine
